notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
The Gravity Maze Demo have some big update to make it more fun to play.


 Updated to Unity 2020.3.48.
 Now you can see the maze loading.
 Better maze generation and start and  end of maze.
 Bugs fix to make the demo playable.

There will be no money making this this game but Tower Builder next big game I am working on, I plan on have a Challenge mode were you can make in game money.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Getting ready for the up coming random demo. I am working on bringing more randomization to 
Maze creation. It not full game update do to having some new bugs with the game. You can try it out by going to the game Library page then go to setting and properties under beta select test branch.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
I have not forgotten about Gravity Maze, I was just taking a brake and working on my next game Tower Builder. There is a Demo of Gravity Maze comming up in May and Full release Q3 2024. 

Right now I am working on giving you more way to make the maze random below is a scream shot me working on the game.

notes.title: Finally other Update V0.6.5.0
notes.content:
I word like to get this update out to you sooner but I had some trouble with the game project. Lost the main scene and had to redo what I had lost from it, I used main scene from project backup.  
Update included

 3 new Levels.
 Can now move maze objects.
 Some UI improvements.
 More bugs fix.

Improve UI

notes.title: Levels are Here
notes.content:
Now you can play levels. There are 100 levels planed. Right now it just mostly just the UI and three levels to play. Do not forget about the Workshop ware you can share your maze. Note level are not complete yet and there some new bugs I just won to get the build out to you.

Other thing

 UI Changes
 Bug fix
